question_or_proposition: For Outfall 001 Flow, does the permit require continuous measurement and reporting of flow in MGD using a totalizing meter, without imposing enforceable numeric effluent limits in the columns marked 'Report MGD' or '***'?
required_context: PART I Section A effluent limits table for Outfall 001
Flow row limit entries 'Report MGD' and '***'
Flow row measurement frequency 'Continuous' and sample type 'Totalizing Meter'
source_locator: farmington/final_permit.pdf, Page 4, Section part_i, Flow row
notes: Resolving how to read the Flow row determines whether numeric limit exceedance applies (Purpose A), whether continuous flow monitoring was required (Purpose B), and how to classify absent flow reporting (Purpose C).
